text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? You're way too good at Paka Petit. 
Trainer-chan, I mad respect you.
choice_data_list:
...A-Aren't you praising me a bit too 
much?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No! The arm calibration, understanding the 
center of gravity... As a gadget geek, I 
can tell, it was flawless!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: It was flawless. And that's why—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: —Ain't no way I'm gonna lose either~!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Putting my tech-geek pride on the line, 
I'll surpass you, Trai-chan! Just you 
watch, okay~?
